ops.value: Design skill for websites and landing pages that look designed, not generated, with the sloplint checker. Use when the user names Hallmark, or when the dfw workflow delegates a marketing/landing page (dfw passes DESIGN.md and brand inputs; use custom mode). Never on an existing design unless the user names Hallmark.
ops.why: Upstream fires on any new build; in dfw it leads marketing surfaces only.
Installed as a plugin, the placeholder must resolve to the real skill directory.
